summary: Added sdk/economy/ledger.py: LedgerEntry, FlowTotals, Ledger and build_ledger (containment-based attribution to exactly one attempted event, otherwise ambiguous or unattributed; partial overlaps do not count; None for unobserved currency and inventory; refuses foreign or out-of-order snapshots; ignores skipped and foreign events), with totals by action, unattributed and ambiguous. Exported from sdk.economy. 9 tests in tests/test_economy_ledger.py including a runner round trip. Documented in docs/baseline/economy-ledger.md.

contract_status_changes.before: Resource and item changes were only visible per action as cost deltas, with no account-level ledger or unattributed flows
contract_status_changes.after: A per-account ledger records every observed currency and item change and attributes it to an action, or marks it unattributed or ambiguous

residual_risks: Attribution relies on journal timestamps and snapshot observation times coming from consistent clocks.
